decisions.reason: The construction dumper was only mentioned, never given its own page, and is a vehicle like the underground loaders and trucks the firm dropped quickly; with no sign of results above aspiration since 2019, problemistic search favours moving its resources to the lift lines.

The inclined furniture lift line had its own page and several models, fits a stable niche of the German moving and handling market, and has likely met modest aspirations, so the firm can carry it on existing slack.
The building material lift line shares technology, parts and service with the furniture lifts and serves steady construction demand, so dropping it would release few resources and offer little gain.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is a single, more complex model, which makes its results less certain, but it builds on the lift know-how and service base, so management is likely to keep it while results stay near aspiration.
